tags.title: Security rule detection rate and false positives vs synthetic ground truth
tags.concept: UNNEST of label arrays, LEFT JOIN, confusion-matrix style conditional aggregation
tags.question: For each injected security scenario, how often did the expected rule category fire, and how many findings occurred on runs with no injected security scenario?
tags.interpretation: Ground truth = injected_faults labels written by the generator (never used by detectors). 'poisoned_document_retrieved' marks runs that retrieved a poisoned KB document without an injected fault - prompt-injection findings there are true detections, not false positives.
